title: add-benchmark-lab-edge-case-runners-and-reporting-pipeline
author: Asha Patel
description:
Context: Benchmark lab has gaps in coverage for several edge-case workloads (ultra-short prompts, extreme long context, streaming aborts, and KV-cache warmup behavior). These gaps made a few regressions go unnoticed in recent perf rollouts. This PR adds representative runners for those edge cases, instruments profiling baselines (cold/warm path), and extends the reporting pipeline to aggregate new metrics and publish per-model baseline comparisons.

Changes: 1) new runners under benchmark-lab/runners/edge_cases for short_seq, long_context, streaming_abort, kv_warmup; 2) profiling baselines and baseline snapshots for cold/warm runs; 3) reporting pipeline updates to ingest new runner outputs, compute per-model delta metrics, and emit dashboard-ready JSON + CSV for downstream visualizations; 4) CI job to run a lightweight smoke of edge-case runners on PRs; 5) docs & runbooks for interpreting edge-case regressions.

Why: catching regressions that only appear on corner workloads reduces silent quality regressions and improves confidence for rollout to Dedicated/Private customers. This is low-risk infra and tooling work with measurable observability improvements.

Checklist: - [x] add runner implementations + unit tests - [x] add profiling baseline collection harness - [x] add reporting pipeline ingestion and aggregation - [x] add lightweight PR CI smoke - [x] update docs/runbook - [x] add Linear ticket references

Related: Linear: ENG-8142 (benchmark lab edge-case coverage), ENG-8210 (reporting pipeline schema), ENG-8311 (kv-cache warmup profiling).
